item.title: Kanagawa Events 2026: Yokohama Fireworks, Tanabata & Hakone Parade
item.description: Kanagawa packs an unusual variety into one prefecture: the harbour glamour of Yokohama, the temples and beaches of Kamakura and Shonan, and the mountain onsen of Hakone. Its 2026 event calendar is just as varied — near-monthly fireworks over Yokohama’s port, one of the Kanto region’s three great Tanabata festivals, a feudal-lord procession through Hakone, and horseback archery at Kamakura’s great shrine. This guide gathers the events worth planning a 2026 trip around, with a month-by-month calendar at the end.

item.title: Miyagi Family Trip: Matsushima Boat Tour, Tanabata Festival & Kokeshi Painting
item.description: Family Travel Guide to Miyagi Prefecture: Exploring Japan’s Family-Friendly Tohoku Gateway Miyagi Prefecture offers international families a perfect blend of coastal beauty, cultural experiences, and child-friendly activities that showcase authentic Japanese traditions without overwhelming young travelers. Here’s your comprehensive guide to exploring this often-overlooked gem with children. 1. Matsushima Bay Boat Tour: Island-Hopping Adventure for All Ages Matsushima Bay, consistently ranked among Japan’s three most scenic views, becomes even more magical when experienced from the water with children.
